Button family

Everything that is not a primary cast button, designed in ChatGPT (free) on 10-05: the frosted + pearl pill finishes, key caps, white-clay helper icons and color icons in raw/. Each family has 2–3 options, the current candy style next to them, and the pick tagged Recommended. Tap any button to see its pressed state.

1 · Game helper buttons

The small pill under every board: a soft 3D white-clay icon + the label, tinted per game. Quieter than the cast buttons so the board stays the star. Every option is one fill + one ChatGPT light map, so every game color, the pressed / used states and dark mode come from the same two sprites.

A · Frosted washRecommended

A pale wash of the game color in the frosted jelly finish; icon + label in the deep game color. Reads as part of the game, never competes with PLAY AGAIN.

2 · Secondary / quiet

Not now, Close, Skip, Cancel, How to play, Sign out, See all, Past words, Gift a friend, Restore purchases. Always next to (or under) a cast button, never louder than it. Text links (Forgot password?) stay text links.

A · Lavender ghost pillRecommended

The frosted pill in a soft lavender, deep-purple Nunito Black. Clearly a button, clearly second.

B · Pearl pill

White pearl pill, purple label. Stands out more on lilac pages.

C · Text only

Deep-purple Nunito Black, no pill, no chevron. Lightest, but loses the tap shape.

3 · Round icon buttons

Close X, share, leaderboard, info, settings, back. The founder rejected bubbles behind the header icons, so A keeps the icons bare.

A · Bare soft 3D iconRecommended

The ChatGPT icon alone (28 pt in a 44 pt hit area), squish on press. Matches the header family exactly.

B · Frosted disc

The icon on a small frosted lavender disc (the helper finish).

C · Pearl disc

The icon on a pearl disc. Most "button-like"; heaviest.

4 · Switches

On/off toggles and the two-way segmented switches (Everyone | Friends, Daily | Unlimited). The candy toggle sprites from the 10-03 night art are already this language, so A keeps them and finishes the rollout (three screens still use the system switch).

A · Candy (keep + finish)Recommended

Frosted track that turns jelly purple, pearl knob; segmented: a glossy purple thumb slides under the choice.

5 · Keyboard keys

Letter, ENTER and delete keys; tile states purple (right spot) · gold (wrong spot) · slate (not in word), per the approved game kit. Each key = its state color + the ChatGPT key light map (nine-slice), so colorblind palettes keep working.

A · Glossy keysRecommended

Pearl keys with the soft top gloss and rounded lip.

6 · VS + pocket games

Mapped onto the families: Challenge / Rematch / Accept / Find match = cast buttons (VS blue, Accept green, art labels where they exist); Decline / See all = quiet A; pocket-game moves (Heads, Tails, Rock…) = helper A tinted per pocket game.
